verdict.rationale: The only on-topic first-party evidence is a single marketing line saying the platform can "confirm payment outcomes and trigger post-purchase actions in real-time." That hints at event-driven actions on payment events, but nothing shows how such triggers are defined or configured. Mandates with decline thresholds and spending limits are authorization controls, not user-defined event→action rules, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: a documented user-definable rule/trigger configuration, a catalog of events that can fire actions, documented action types or a callback mechanism, API/reference docs for the post-purchase trigger feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
